C0706.title: Baidu AI-Generated False Conviction Information About a Lawyer Constitutes Reputation Infringement
C0706.summary: Nanjing-based lawyer Li Xiaoliang discovered that Baidu's AI-powered search assistant, when queried with his name, erroneously generated text stating he had been sentenced to three years in prison, accompanied by a photo of him in legal robes.
